Proposition
[Pullback pseudometric] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0411, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0520 ↗ prop:chow-iii-g3-pullback-metric 1. appJ:G.3\group Metric spaces

For a map $f:X o (Y,d_Y)$, the function $(f^*d_Y)(x_1,x_2)=d_Y(f(x_1),f(x_2))$ is a pseudometric on $X$, and it is a metric if $f$ is injective.
Proof

\sketch The function is nonnegative and symmetric because $d_Y$ is. For any three points $x_1,x_2,x_3\in X$,

\[ (f^*d_Y)(x_1,x_3) \leq (f^*d_Y)(x_1,x_2)+(f^*d_Y)(x_2,x_3) \]

by the triangle inequality in $Y$. Finally, if $f$ is injective and $x_1 eq x_2$, then $f(x_1) eq f(x_2)$, so $(f^*d_Y)(x_1,x_2)>0$.

□
